verdict.rationale: A GPU accelerator would not normally be judged on job scheduling, but AMD's Instinct documentation lists Spur, a first-party "AI-native job scheduler" that is drop-in compatible with Slurm and does GPU-first scheduling. That brings the axis into scope. The evidence is a single one-line mention: it shows job scheduling but never documents recurring or cron-style schedules or workflow orchestration. Missing for 10: explicit recurring/periodic job scheduling, workflow chaining, detailed Spur documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
